title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Billing Dispute Timeframes and Credit Balance Refund Threshold
content:
Timeframes for billing error disputes, and the credit balance refund threshold, for each Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier:

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days after the statement on which a charge first appeared during which a dispute may be filed (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days within which a dispute is acknowledged in writing (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Maximum days from filing within which a dispute is resolved (calendar days) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Credit balance above which the cardholder may ask for a refund (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

The figures are the same on every tier. The refund threshold is a strict one: a credit balance must be above 1.00 for the cardholder to ask for it to be refunded, so a credit balance of exactly 1.00 does not qualify and one of 1.01 does.
